runs.purpose: HGNC alias/name resolution layer + frozen S1-A re-run (implements PROTOCOL_PA2.md v1)
runs.notes: 3 earlier attempts failed on implementation KeyErrors (pa.read_v14_identity has no e1_split key; target_stats lacks two v1-appended fields; jaaks stats lacks overlap_D1); all failed after mapping_table_v2.csv was written but before pa2.json; no rule/threshold changes were made, final successful run overwrote the table
pa2.json and mapping_table_v2.csv SHA256 identical across repeated runs of the same script version; sys.dont_write_bytecode=True so no __pycache__ is created in the study dir

hgnc_complete_set.txt.version: HGNC complete set, 45277 data rows, all Approved; version date max(date_modified) = 2026-10-15

tokens.note: runtime token accounting is not available to the agent; recorded as null (not 0)

primary_variant: V2-A (base v1 exact + token-symbol + token-alias/prev + segment-name/alias_name; ambiguity resolved only when it cannot change downstream argmax)
notes: response values were never read: v1.4 parsed with csv.reader and positional access to identity columns only; the 12 response/derived columns appear solely as header-name strings; grep on mapping_table_v2.csv for response column names returns 0 matches
P-A v1 products were not modified (SHA256 before/after equal, audit A5); v1 S1-A numbers were recomputed inside pa2.py and equal the frozen pa.json values (audit A3)

v2 gain is driven mainly by the protein-full-name layer (590 drugs, 322 exclusive) rather than token alias/prev (533, 271 exclusive); generic short HGNC aliases (52 tokens with hnorm len<=3) are a known precision risk: dropping len<=2 changes 55 labels and dropping len<=3 changes 111 labels -- reported as pre-registered sensitivity V2-D and diagnostics

both-unseen unit counts are not monotone in mapping coverage because the PA split is defined on the mapped-drug list; V2-B (segment-name only) has both-unseen PA 2078 < v1 2682 despite higher coverage -- reported explicitly
rule A semantics (gene-set co-membership, not mechanism) is unchanged by v2; taxane->tubulin family bias persists
all hash values are SHA256 unless a name says otherwise
